notes.title: ⚔️ New Content & Fixes – Update Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Survivors,[/p][p]A fresh update has arrived with [b]new quests, items, NPCs, and panels[/b], along with some key fixes and improvements. Let’s dive into what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🆕 New Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]📜 New Quest[/b] – A brand-new adventure has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🛡️ New Armor (Level 30)[/b] – Equip yourself with stronger protection once you reach level 30.[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/de9ddbaaf779610bfa042fbebfd6629abde66713.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]🧩 Memory Fragment[/b] – A new collectible has been introduced to expand the story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🧑‍🦱 New NPC: Hector[/b] – Meet Hector, a new character bringing fresh interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🖼️ New Button Picture[/b] – UI refreshed with a new button design.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/dc602b902f8ed2734b77d584798587e18f81f0e9.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🖥️ New Panels[/h2][list][*][p][b]⚙️ Control Panel[/b] – A new interface to manage controls more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌀 Portal Panel[/b] – Added for easier portal interactions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/c27756ba065e2668a27e812465d3244ae1953074.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]☠️ Dead Panel[/b] – New UI for handling death-related information.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/1095aeeea0906b3baa7436f9b231b087f656c61b.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌍 World & Exploration[/h2][list][*][p][b]🗺️ New Map[/b] – Explore brand new terrain and challenges.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/52bf0def975d1d913f5f20813d23eec16636f879.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]🚗 More Cars[/b] – Additional vehicles have been added across the map to expand exploration and survival possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]📜 Rampage Quest[/b] – Fixed issues with this quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📦 Crafting Menu[/b] – Removed duplicate [b]Plastic Storage[/b] from the player’s crafting list.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔥 This update continues to expand the world and refine your survival experience. Log in now to try the new quests, armor, panels, and map updates — and let us know your feedback![/p][p]See you in the wasteland,
[b]Shatterland Dev[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🌍 New Content & Big Fixes – Update Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Survivors,[/p][p]Another big step forward is here! This update brings new items, zones, a world boss, and tons of fixes to make the game smoother than ever. Let’s dive into the details:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🆕 New Items & Crafting[/h2][list][*][p][b]🧩 Plastic Scrap[/b] – A new resource to gather.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🤠 Cowboy Hat[/b] – Stylish protection for your survivor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎒 Hiking Backpack[/b] – +20 extra slots to carry more loot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🥩 Zombie Meat[/b] – A fresh addition to your inventory (handle with care!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]🔦 Camp Lamp[/b] – Now requires [b]Plastic, Battery, and Electric Parts[/b] to craft. [i](thanks to @rcjoe69 for the suggestion!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]📦 Small Plastic Chest[/b] – Craftable storage option made with plastic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🪑 New Models[/b] – Updated 3D models for the [b]wooden chair, table, repair bench, and workbench[/b].
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/5c72d61a0b4965032ff639f0b44103d2b0e45f6c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌍 New Zones & World Boss[/h2][list][*][p][b]🗺️ Expanded Map[/b] – A brand new part of the map is now open for exploration.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/5549abaf09c8c13e88d28d464175fa429702ef3e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/79bddabc795a8be7a69c1eb8f1474e5a36960ebd.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]🌴 New Spawn Point[/b] – Survivors can now start on the beach.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🐝 Hive System[/b] – Hives can now be destroyed, including on the bus. If you don’t have a gas mask, destroying the hive is your only way forward!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/41fcf1683367b210d5bd4b8405971c3883f65a13.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]👹 World Boss[/b] – A massive new challenge awaits SOON. The picture might look small… but trust us, it isn’t.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/836368555d5f8f8337688d4e91dbacdcae851b3b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/eed4e9bca3d9529311df46aae2cb69938ffee5f0.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]🏦 Bank in the Big City[/b] – Take on a [b]money heist[/b] and raid the new bank location.

[/p][previewyoutube="QjKj1ipu54o;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚔️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]⚡ Dash System[/b] – Fixed stamina drain and climbing interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎮 Boss Fight[/b] – Fixed black screen issue during boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🚢 Abandoned Cargo Ship[/b] – Loot system corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌊 Water Collision[/b] – Fixed bodies colliding incorrectly with water.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🧟 Zombie Stash[/b] – No longer visible on the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📍 Map Markers[/b] – Various fixes for better navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🛏️ Sleeping Bag[/b] – Now works properly on foundations.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/291694a9882c47eb4fecb6d2819cfa5cf48b9745.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]🧱 Wooden Wall Icon[/b] – Corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🪜 Ladders[/b] – Old placeholder ladders have been removed; real ladder models are now placed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]💥 Mutant Zombie[/b] – Explosion now triggers correctly [b]2 seconds after death[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌱 Resource Nodes[/b] – All resources now have a visible health bar when gathering.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🐗 Animal Drops[/b] – Fixed drops from boar, chicken, and tentacles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📜 Rampage Quest[/b] – Fixed text for gear score requirement.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎉 What’s Next[/h2][p]The [b]last big playtest update[/b] is now complete. From here, the focus will shift to [b]bug fixing, polish, and preparing the demo build[/b] for Steam Next Fest this October. Expect smaller updates aimed at improving stability and gameplay experience.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔥 The new content is live — explore the expanded world, take on the world boss, raid the new bank, and try out all the fresh items and fixes.[/p][p]See you in the wasteland,

Satterland Dev.[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 The Update is Live!
notes.content:
[h1][/h1][p]Hey Survivors,[/p][p]The wait is over — today’s update is officially live! Jump in now and try out all the new systems, fixes, and improvements we’ve been working on.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔫 Gameplay & Combat[/h2][list][*][p][b]💥 Rocket Launcher[/b] – Bring the big boom to your fights![/p][/*][*][p][b]⚡ Dash Ability[/b] – Press [b]Shift once[/b] to quickly dash in the direction you want.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🧟 Zombie Behavior Update[/b] – Zombies Explosive no longer explode instantly on collision. They now explode [b]2 seconds after death[/b], making encounters more strategic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🔫 Weapon Fix[/b] – SCAR is now properly fixed and no longer showing as an UZI.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Systems & Mechanics[/h2][list][*][p][b]🎚️ Item Level System[/b] – Items now have required levels. You can only equip them if your character level is high enough.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🪜 Ladder System[/b] – Climb your way to new places with the new ladder mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎁 Redeem Code System[/b] – You can now claim rewards with special redeem codes!
👉 Go to the [b]Event Tab in your Inventory[/b], enter the code [b]Demo2025[/b], and receive a special gift.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🔫 Gear Score Update[/b] – Weapons now properly count toward your gear score.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🗺️ Exploration & Survival[/h2][list][*][p][b]🗺️ Death Marker[/b] – When you die, a marker will appear on the map so you can easily track down and recover your body.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌍 Zone Discoveries[/b] – Fixes applied to zone discovery so exploration works as intended.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📚 Tutorials & Guidance[/h2][list][*][p][b]More Tutorial Information[/b] – New details added to help players understand the mechanics better.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚠️ Demo & Full Release Info[/h2][list][*][p][b]Demo[/b] – Max level is capped at [b]50[/b]. Achievements are not available in the demo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Game[/b] – Achievements will be included in the full release.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔥 This update is live right now — go try it out, explore the new systems, and don’t forget to redeem your gift with the code [b]Demo2025[/b] in the Event Tab![/p][p]See you in the wasteland,
[b]Althurius \[UNRL][/b][/p]

notes.title: ⚔️ Shatterland Playtest – Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]A brand new update is here with [b]rarity systems, new icons, fixes, and world improvements[/b]! Thanks again for all your feedback—it helps shape every patch.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧟 Gameplay & Survival[/h2][list][*][p][b]Zombie & Bandit Dismemberment[/b]: They can now lose arms during combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rampage Boss Health[/b]: Increased from [b]3000 → 5800[/b] (#PoorRampage, you were too easy 👀).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skip Night Feature[/b]: Use a bed or sleeping bag to fast-forward through the night.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Fight Fixes[/b]: Adjusted combat and loot. Legendary items now drop properly.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔫 Weapons & Loot[/h2][list][*][p][b]Weapon Rarity System[/b] added: Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mystical.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapon & Item Icons[/b] for rarities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rarity Effects[/b]: Items now have visual effects based on rarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltip Updates[/b]: Clearer item descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Repair Bench Fix[/b]: Now works for all weapons—including melee.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AK-74 & AK-74u Fixes[/b]: Improved aiming + fixed first-person view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M4 Scope Fix[/b]: Corrected red dot alignment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Injection Bug[/b]: Fixed across weapons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Loot[/b]: Legendary items added.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌍 World & Map[/h2][list][*][p][b]New POIs[/b] added to the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiation Zones[/b]: Fixed floating items and new bomb event radiation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gas Added[/b] to Bandit base.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bus Fix[/b]: Now blends properly near the motel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tentacle Fixed[/b] near Airfield walls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Immersion[/b]: Removed map icons—you must now discover zones by exploring.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Tutorial Text[/b] for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Crafting Icons[/b]: Improved hut image in the crafting menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Campfire & Furnace[/b]: Notes added to crafting section explaining their function.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Quality of Life[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game Version Display[/b]: Now visible in bottom-right corner—helps check if you and your friends are on the same version.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Input Settings[/b]: Flip cars control can now be reassigned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Workbench & Door Fixes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision Fixes[/b]: General improvements + plane collision corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Friendlier Nights[/b]: Slightly adjusted lighting.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔊 Audio[/h2][list][*][p][b]Grenade Fixes[/b]: Now works properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rampage Boss[/b]: Added unique boss fight music.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💭 What’s Next[/h2][p]We’re laying the foundation for deeper progression with rarities, events, and survival systems. Keep sharing your feedback—it’s driving the development forward![/p][p]Thanks for surviving with me,
— Shatterland Dev[/p]

notes.title: 📝 Dev Update – Early Access, But a Full Game
notes.content:
[h1][/h1][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]I want to share some details about how [b]\[Game Name][/b] will launch and evolve.[/p][h2]🎮 Early Access – Already Complete[/h2][p]The game will release in [b]Early Access[/b], but unlike many Early Access titles, it will already be a [b]complete experience[/b] from the start:[/p][list][*][p]✅ A [b]finished map[/b] (no fake walls, no empty placeholders)[/p][/*][*][p]✅ All planned [b]weapons, items, and zombies[/b] included[/p][/*][*][p]✅ A [b]seasonal event system[/b] with collectibles you can trade to NPCs for rewards[/p][/*][/list][p]So while it’s labeled Early Access, you’ll be playing the [b]full game[/b] from day one.[/p][h2]🔧 Why Early Access?[/h2][p]The main reason is to make sure the game gets:[/p][list][*][p]Thorough [b]bug fixing[/b] based on wider player testing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polish and balance updates[/b] where needed[/p][/*][*][p]Ongoing support with [b]new items, seasonal events, and improvements[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Once the game is fully [b]stable and polished[/b], it will leave Early Access and become a complete release.
[/p][h2]🌐 Offline Play (Coming Later)[/h2][p]For players who prefer solo play without a Steam connection, an [b]offline version[/b] will be made available [b]after release[/b]. This way you’ll be able to enjoy the game fully in single-player mode even without being online or connected to steam.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]👉 Thanks for joining me on this journey! Your feedback during Early Access will be key to making sure the final polished release is the best it can be.[/p][p]— Shatterland Dev[/p]

notes.title: ⚔️ Shatterland Playtest – Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve pushed another big update to the [b]Shatterland Playtest[/b]! This patch brings [b]new items, world improvements, and fixes[/b] to polish the survival experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌍 World & Map[/h2][list][*][p][b]Floating Trees Fixed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fog Improvements[/b]: Fixed and adjusted for better atmosphere (2 passes).[/p][/*][*][p][b]More POIs[/b]: Added new points of interest to explore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Planet in the Sky[/b]: Expanding the world’s mysterious vibe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Spawn Points[/b] in the main map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed One Bed[/b] in the starting house.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Almost half the map completed[/b] with new zones and visuals.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🧟 Gameplay & Combat[/h2][list][*][p][b]Raid Reworked into a Boss Fight[/b] for a more epic challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rampage Quest Updated[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Zombie Footsteps Fixed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rampage Sound Fixed[/b] + [b]New Music[/b] added to the Rampage boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Loot Fixed[/b] with a new [b]mystical loot effect[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombie Level 10[/b] added for tougher encounters.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎒 Items & Loot[/h2][list][*][p][b]Firefighter Axe[/b]: New melee weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items Added[/b]: Battery, Car Battery, Tape, Pencil, Painkillers, Medical Box, Bottle of Alcohol.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Electronic Parts[/b] introduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot All Button[/b]: Improved for smoother use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Loot Effect[/b]: Updated for a mystical look.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🚗 Vehicles[/h2][list][*][p][b]Car Interaction[/b]: You can now [b]push cars forward[/b] to help flip or move them. PRESS: Z in cars[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎶 UI & Quality of Life[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game Version Display[/b]: Now visible in the bottom right corner—easily check if you and your friends are on the same version (helps with zombie/lag desync issues).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist Button Fixed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Debug Menu[/b] for a cleaner playtest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Friend Name Visibility Fixed[/b] (see names at distance).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory Close Fix[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Event Module[/b]: Added in the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joe’s Dialogue[/b]: English text corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Nights[/b]: Darker, more immersive atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💭 What’s Next[/h2][p]The world of [b]Shatterland[/b] continues to grow—more zones, events, and survival content are on the way. Thank you for all your feedback and bug reports, it helps us improve every single patch![/p][p]Thanks for surviving with us,
— The Shatterland Dev[/p]

notes.title: ⚔️ Shatterland Playtest – New Update
notes.content:

This patch brings [b]new weapons, improved events, bug fixes, and world changes[/b]—all thanks to your testing and feedback.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧟 Gameplay & Balance[/h2][list][*][p][b]Explosion Zombie[/b]: No longer one-shots you (thanks @KNOXVILLE for the feedback!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]AK-74u Added[/b]: A brand-new weapon to expand your arsenal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Uzi Added[/b]: Now available in [b]military crates[/b] (not just the Debug Menu). Comes equipped with a scope and grip.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scar Damage[/b]: Adjusted for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Zombie Animation[/b]: Fixed for smoother combat experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gas Mask & Night Vision Bug[/b]: Fixed—these items no longer disappear when dying.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grenade Damage Fixed[/b]: Grenades now deal proper damage as intended.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌍 Map & World[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Event Types[/b] added to the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stone Puzzle[/b]: Simplified for easier completion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radioactive Zone[/b]: A dangerous new area to 👀[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔊 Audio[/h2][list][*][p][b]Barrel Sound[/b]: Now plays correctly when thrown and explodes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brother Fight Sound Fixes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Helicopter notes.title: 🧟 Shatterland Playtest – New Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]Today’s update brings a [b]new zombie type, new weapons, better loot systems, and plenty of fixes & improvements[/b] to make your survival journey smoother. We’re also starting to give some areas (like the Airfield) a darker, [b]Once Human-inspired vibe[/b] 👀.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧟 Zombie & Combat Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Zombie Type[/b]: A fresh threat to watch out for![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Boss Zombie Animation[/b] for more intense encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombie Run Speed Adjusted[/b] for better pacing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombie Levels Added[/b]: Face stronger enemies as you explore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crowbar (New Melee Weapon)[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Can only be looted from [b]Purple Chests[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Homemade Wooden Baseball Bat[/b]: Craftable to help fight back and reclaim your gear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiation Zone Damage Increased[/b]: Now [b]10 dmg (was 5)[/b] for added challenge.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎒 Loot & Items[/h2][list][*][p][b]Backpack[/b]: Now found in clothing crates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Carrot Seeds[/b]: Plant and harvest to sustain your survival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gas Tank System[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Find [b]Gas Tanks[/b] and siphon fuel with empty canisters.[/p][/*][*][p]Use them to refill cars.
[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MyIbzpDHenw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Loot All Button[/b]: Added for faster looting![/p][/*][*][p][b]Chest Changes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Removing a chest with a full inventory now drops it to the ground instead of deleting—pick it up once you have space.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Jimmy the Trader[/b]: Now sells [b]Grenades[/b] and [b]Molotovs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mines & Traps[/b]: Now have [b]red lights[/b] for better visibility (thanks Free Beer!).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🏗️ World & Map[/h2][list][*][p][b]Airfield Rework[/b]: In progress—designed for a darker, “Once Human” vibe.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/acb24cdd6e1e0e31ed27590bafd776b6691d8e8c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bunker Entrance Fix[/b].
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/d63bf7c9473feda2cc5d4300411a7f4460e64f57.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ground Fixes[/b] for smaller houses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Loot Added[/b] in houses.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/79608cfa5882063fd008f01c79db8d7040113b35.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Boat Edited[/b] for improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Building Item Models[/b]: Improved 3D visuals.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚙️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Hammer Fix[/b]: No longer removes ground.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Attachments Bug[/b] fixed (thanks @Gaming Simulations).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scar Weapon Price[/b] adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Fixes[/b]: Underwater sound corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corpse System Update[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Easier to find your corpse.[/p][/*][*][p]Corpses [b]no longer disappear after 10 minutes[/b]—take your time to get your gear back![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Debug Menu[/b]: Re-added temporarily for testing or recovering lost items.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Quality of Life[/h2][list][*][p][b]Interaction Button[/b]: Works properly when changed in the settings.

[/p][previewyoutube="wHuMxTh1ohw;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][*][p][b]Inventory Sticky Icon[/b]: Fixed when moving items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot All Button[/b]: Added for convenience (requested feature).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💭 What’s Next[/h2][p]We’re continuing to improve the [b]world atmosphere, survival systems, and gameplay loop[/b] with upcoming events and new content. Your feedback helps us push forward every day, so please keep sharing your thoughts![/p][p]Thanks for surviving with us,
— The Shatterland Dev[/p]

notes.title: ⚔️ Shatterland Playtest Update ⚔️
notes.content: [h1][/h1][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]We’re back with another update to the [b]Shatterland Playtest[/b], bringing you new features, improvements, and important fixes. Thanks again for all your support and bug reports—every bit of feedback helps us make the game stronger![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎨 New Features & Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Car Color Editing[/b]: Customize your ride with new car color editing options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bulletproof Vest[/b]: Now available in clothing crates—gear up for extra protection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Garage Repairs[/b]: Cars can now be repaired in the garage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gary the Trader[/b]: A new trader has arrived to take over Jimmy’s spot.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🏗️ Visual & Model Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Chest Model Update[/b]: The 3D model for chests has been refreshed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lamp Update[/b]: Candles have been reworked into lamps for better immersion.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Rifle Ammo Collision[/b]: Fixed issues with rifle ammo colliding incorrectly (thanks @sector & @KNOXVILLE!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interaction Button[/b]: Now properly updates when changed in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory Fix[/b]: No more sticky item icons when moving things around.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Raid Fixes[/b]: Addressed bugs and issues in raids.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trader Jimmy Fixes[/b]: Resolved problems with Jimmy before Gary took over.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💭 What’s Next[/h2][p]We’re continuing to polish the playtest build with more features, better stability, and gameplay improvements. Your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for surviving with us and helping shape [b]Shatterland[/b]. See you out there![/p][p]— The Shatterland Dev[/p]

notes.title: ⚔️ Shatterland Playtest Update ⚔️
notes.content: [h1][/h1][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve been hard at work improving the playtest experience for [b]Shatterland[/b], and this update brings a mix of new features, balance changes, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements. Thank you for all your feedback—it helps us make the game better every day![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Debug Menu[/b]: Added for cases where you may have lost items during updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Trader – Jimmy[/b]: A new friendly face has arrived on the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sleeping Bag[/b]: A new survival essential.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Big Chest for Trucks[/b]: More storage space for your travels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bandage Stack Size[/b]: Increased to [b]999[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot Expansion[/b]: Added new items to discover in the world.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue Options[/b]: More choices when speaking with [b]Joe[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hammer Retrieval[/b]: Items placed in the map can now be retrieved with the hammer (thanks @Weber Systems!).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌍 World & Map Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Points of Interest (POI)[/b]: Explore fresh locations across the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Markers for POIs[/b]: Find them more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiation Zone[/b]: Ground visuals fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Floating Items[/b]: Corrected (thanks @Respawnd!).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]👥 Multiplayer Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Invite Friends to Tutorial[/b]: You can now bring a friend with you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lobby Change[/b]: Invites no longer happen in the lobby.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚖️ Balancing[/h2][list][*][p][b]Rampage Health[/b]: Increased from [b]200 → 3000[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombie Health[/b]: Adjusted to [b]100[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crawler Health[/b]: Adjusted to [b]75[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gumpy Health[/b]: Adjusted to [b]1000[/b] (was 2000).[/p][/*][*][p][b]MREs[/b]: Now restore more food & health compared to Small Food Packs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trader Updates[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Traders now display item counts when buying/selling.[/p][/*][*][p]Tires can now be sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Radiation Mask price set to [b]50[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Night Vision price set to [b]50[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎯 UI & Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Trader UI[/b]: Cleaner and more functional.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crosshair Removed when Aiming with Sniper[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coop-Breader Fix[/b]: Chickens taking damage and being destroyed fixed (thanks @Charley Tank!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Fix[/b]: Eating sound no longer plays when equipping clothing.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed several bugs in the radiation zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple floating item spawns.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💭 Coming Soon[/h2][p]We’re also thinking about [b]updating the Playtest Build[/b] to make it even more stable and feature-rich. Stay tuned for more details soon.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for being part of the playtest and helping us shape Shatterland into something great. Keep sending us your feedback, reporting bugs, and letting us know what you’d like to see next![/p][p]— The Shatterland Dev[/p]

notes.title: Devlog Update – Trader Changes & New Quest!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve made some exciting changes to improve the gameplay experience in this update:[/p][h3]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Trader Changes[/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Trader’s position has been moved[/b] to a new location. This should make your visits feel fresh and add a bit more exploration to your runs.[/p][/*][/list][h3]📜 New Quest: [i]Meet the Trader[/i][/h3][list][*][p]A brand-new quest has been added: [b]Meet the Trader[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]This quest will guide new players to the Trader’s location and introduce them to the trading system.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔫 New Item for Sale[/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Pistol[/b] is now available for purchase from the Trader![/p][/*][*][p]This gives players an early option for ranged combat and expands your choices when gearing up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628828/c3d9c634ef8509736812868b72ae4d33ef02c804.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]That’s all for this update! As always, thank you for playing and supporting the game. Your feedback helps us improve every step of the way.[/p][p]Stay safe out there, Survivors.[/p][p]— The Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update with a mix of fixes, improvements, and fresh additions to make your survival experience smoother and more immersive. Here’s what’s new:[/p][h2]⚔️ Gameplay & Mechanics[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted [b]axe durability[/b] for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]sniper ammunition[/b] to the [b]starter trader’s inventory[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the [b]fuel supply[/b] in the helicopter.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the [b]truck’s storage box size[/b] for more capacity.[/p][/*][*][p]Temporarily [b]removed the loot animation[/b] to streamline gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐺 Audio & Visual Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed [b]zombie sound effects[/b] to make them clearer and more immersive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]gunfire cutting off background music[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]drinking water animation[/b] for smoother play.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the [b]EXP bar color to blue[/b] for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🗺️ World & Map[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the [b]gas mask collision issue[/b] where it could fall under the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]compass and minimap mismatch[/b] (North vs. South directions).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few [b]new POIs (Points of Interest)[/b] to the map for exploration.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]That’s it for this round of updates! 🚀
Thank you for all the feedback—you’re helping us make the game better every day.[/p][p]See you in the wasteland,
[b]The Dev Team[/b][/p]
